name: Project NOMAD
description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server: Wikipedia, books, courses, maps and optional local AI, all served from hardware you own with no Internet required.
author: Crosstalk Solutions

form_fields.label: Application key
form_fields.hint: AdonisJS APP_KEY used to sign NOMAD sessions and cookies. Generated once; changing it invalidates existing sessions.

form_fields.label: Database password
form_fields.hint: Password for the nomad_user MySQL account.

form_fields.label: Database root password
form_fields.hint: MySQL root password. Not used by the application at runtime.
